news.title: Metaplanet denies selling bitcoin worth $320 million
news.summary: Metaplanet CEO dismisses bitcoin sale rumors, confirms 43,000 BTC holdings

news.title: Bitcoin firms ask AI labs for same tools attackers already have
news.summary: Coinbase, Block, BitGo and dozens of others signed a letter arguing that safety guardrails on frontier models are blocking legitimate security work while adversaries face no such limits.

news.title: Speculation on dogecoin is back to October 2025 levels. The price is down 70%
news.summary: Futures positioning has rebuilt to levels last seen when dogecoin traded at three times today's price, and more than three accounts are betting on a rebound for every one betting against.

news.title: Bitcoin slips near $63,500 as traders look past CPI to Fed’s next tests
news.summary: An in-line inflation print removed a tail risk but gave BTC little reason to rally, leaving Jackson Hole, jobs data and the next CPI release as the market’s next catalysts.

news.title: Prediction markets should dial back faulty filings for incentives to boost trading: CFTC
news.summary: The U.S. regulator of platforms such as Kalshi and Polymarket suggests the industry is getting into bad compliance habits that may allow for market abuse.

news.title: Securitize falls 20% after earnings miss as tokenization revenue falls short
news.summary: Tokenized assets hit a record and trading activity jumped, but revenue slipped in the firm’s first earnings report since going public.

news.title: Morgan Stanley's infrastructure partner Zerohash rebuffed in pitch to be U.S. trust bank
news.summary: Zerohash, which handles crypto plumbing for Morgan Stanley's E*Trade, said it's planning on re-filing and hoping for a swift resolution.

news.title: Goldman Sachs leaps into bitcoin income ETFs with $2.25 billion NEOS buyout
news.summary: The $2.25 billion deal expands Goldman’s derivative platform to $130 billion in total ETF assets, taking direct aim at BlackRock's rival BITA fund, according to an analyst.

news.title: Lenovo profits soar past expectations on AI computers, servers and services
news.summary: Lenovo Group on Thursday became the latest company in the build-out of artificial intelligence to report soaring profits that caught investors by surprise.

news.title: Cisco sees record results from an AI ‘supercycle,’ but its stock pulls back
news.summary: An 18% revenue surge and blowout 2027 forecast weren’t enough to sustain Cisco’s stock momentum.

news.title: My wife can claim $900 at 62. Should she take it now — or wait for her spousal benefit?
news.summary: “She was a teacher at a school district, so didn’t put much into Social Security.”

news.title: I found a $100 bill in the communal washer at my Airbnb. What should I do?
news.summary: “The landlord has not been here in months, so I assume it was a previous tenant.”

news.title: ‘The market is obviously on fire’: Should I take $1,000 from my brokerage account to pay off my car loan?
Is $1 million enough for a household to retire? The answer keeps changing.

news.title: China’s next economic ambition: workshop for the Muslim world
news.summary: Chinese exporters are moving into halal food, cosmetics and fashion, but success in this vast market depends on something harder to manufacture than cheap goods: trust.
